verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Token2 verifying attestation statements at registration or enforcing an allow-list of approved key models. The closest items are adjacent: an AAGUID lookup for certified authenticators, a browser WebAuthn demo, and a bulk Entra ID enrollment tool. None of these documents attestation verification or model enforcement, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can verify device attestation at registration to enforce that only genuine, approved key models are enrolled
